paite: Pathian hon hihhatpa pahtawi in nuamtak in la sa unla; Jakob' Pathian pahtawi in nuamtak in kikou un.
heading: Asaph La / Ankuangluina La
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

paite: Phatna la sa unla, khuangta, kaihging ngaihnophuai, pekging toh hon tawi un.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

paite: Kha thak in pengkul mut unla, kha lik a i ankuangluina thupi ni in.
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

paite: Israelte ding a dan thuseh ahi ngal a, Jakob' Pathian dan ahi.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

paite: Huai Joseph lak a thu theihsakna ding a aseh ahi. Aigupta gam tung a apaikhiak lai in, ka theih louh pau ka zak lai in.
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

paite: Aliangzang thil gik a pan in ka lasuan a, loh a kipan akhutte khahkhiak in a-om hi.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

paite: Mangbat ni in na hon sam a, ka hon humbit a; van-ging bukna mun ah ka hon dawng hi; Meribah tuite ah ka hon ze-et ahi. Selah
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

paite: Ka mite aw, ngaikhia unla, ka hon theihsak bang in; Israel aw, ka thu ngaikhe nuam hi le uteh aw!
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

paite: Gamdang pathian himhim na lak uah a-om ding ahi kei; midang pathian himhim na biak ding uh leng ahi kei hi.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

paite: Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi a, Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhepa tak; na kam uh liankat un, ka hihdim ding hi.
english: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

paite: Himahleh ka mite'n ka aw angaikhe kei ua; Israelte'n hon deih kei uhi.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

paite: Huchi in alungtang uh genhakdan bang zel a om ding in ka khahzanta ahi, amau hoihsak bang a a-omna ding un.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

paite: Aw, ka mite'n ka thu ngaikhia in, Israelte ka lampite ah pai le u aw.
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

paite: Amelmate uh ka hihneu zok in, amau galte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

paite: TOUPA hote akiang ah akipelut ding uhi; amau hun bel a om nilouh ding ahi.
english: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

paite: Nou bel buh hoihpen in ka hon vak ding hi; suangpi a khuaizu in ka a hon hon taisak ding ahi.
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
